decision.reason: [ev-d324cbe21699] is a one-line changelog entry under "Other work". It says only that the deprecated go-gitlab Go dependency was replaced with client-go, and points to PR #21175. It names no operator-facing subject such as a feature, config key or API. It also doesn't say whether anything operators can see changes, which environments are exposed, or what happens if an operator does nothing, so the change, applicability and consequence can't be written from it. We need the PR or release-note detail that states whether GitLab-related behaviour changes for operators.
